0x000850.en: 「With what I've got now...@ this is as far as I go...!」

0x000949.en: 「Damn it!@ You won't get me next time!」

0x000A72.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000AAA.en: 「Oh dear...@ How uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000BAE.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@ Not funny at all...」

0x000C02.en: 「I blew it...!@ Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000D53.en: 「This is as far as I go... the rest is yours.」

0x000DFF.en: 「No good, I've taken too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000E4C.en: 「I give. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E8A.en: 「Eek, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F7C.en: 「Ngh... So I'm going out like a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x001033.en: 「Owowow... I give, my math was off.」

0x0010B8.en: 「Ngh...! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x00116C.en: 「I'm sorry... I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x0011A1.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my strength...!」

0x0011E5.en: 「I can't fight any longer! Pulling back!」

0x00128D.en: 「To be taken down here...@ I'm not ready yet...!」

0x0012DB.en: 「No good, I can't hold out! Pulling back!」

0x001396.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x0013C5.en: 「No good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001403.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001432.en: 「I can't go on any further. I'll take my leave.」

0x0014BD.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll have to fall back...!」

0x0016E1.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001821.en: 「This is as far as I go!!」

0x001850.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x0019D9.en: 「If they wanted to crush us, they'd have done it in the first move.@ The fact that they haven't means they may have@ some other objective.」

0x001A75.en: 「All units, hold position at combat ready.@ Don't stray from the Kurogane.」

0x001AC8.en: 「B-but if they make the first move...!」

0x001B0B.en: 「Firing blindly is dangerous.@ Follow Major Kai's orders.」

0x001C08.en: 「Then let's buy as much time as we can.」

0x001C3C.en: 「...Looks like they've been monitoring our movements.」

0x001CA7.en: 「They warped in right on top of us like that.@ They must have seen us get pinned down@ in that last battle.」

0x001DA9.en: 「...A gravity-space warp on our first deployment@ sure is nerve-wracking, isn't it.」

0x001E1E.en: 「Only that machine's a different type...@ Could it be the commander's unit?」

0x001E74.en: 「Oh my, they're calm. Just what you'd expect@ from battle-hardened veterans, I suppose.」

0x001EF2.en: 「Yeah, I'll try hailing them on an open channel.」

0x001F48.en: 「This is Major Kai Kitamura of the Earth Federation@ Army Special Tactics Instructor Corps. Are you...@ the Inspectors?」

0x002038.en: 「An odd way of speaking, Major Kai.」

0x00208E.en: 「Just so you know,@ it's not that the translator's acting up,@ and we're not the <Inspectors>, either.」

0x002133.en: 「On your planet, we'd be the ones@ they call the 'Guests.'」

0x0021A5.en: 「That's right.@ I'm their battle commander, Zebris Forschwa...@ you can just call me Zeb.」

0x002272.en: 「You've got a pretty good idea, haven't you?」

0x0022DD.en: 「That's the one.@ Though the Huckebein got ruined@ when someone else butted in.」

0x00234F.en: 「So your goal is the same as the Inspectors'.@ What's your relationship to them?」

0x0023AE.en: 「Hmm, well... rivals, I guess you'd say.」

0x0023F1.en: 「So the same source, but a different faction?」

0x00243A.en: 「Now it's my turn to ask. Where did@ the rest of them go? We've been looking@ too, but we just can't find them.」

0x0024E8.en: 「...And that's why you set your sights on us.」

0x002522.en: 「Well, whatever.@ Now hurry up and disarm.」

0x002575.en: 「I'd rather avoid a pointless fight,@ and I want to take your machines@ as intact as I can, you see.」

0x002656.en: 「Ah, one more thing.@ Your main base is going through@ some real trouble right about now.」

0x0026ED.en: 「We learned our lesson from the Inspectors' failure.@ Decided to crush the head in one blow.」

0x002761.en: (Then Guest units have warped in@ at other locations too...!)

0x0027B4.en: 「So, what'll it be?@ Resisting here is pointless.」

0x0028D0.en: 「I-it's not a dream! The Steel Dragon Squadron came for us!」

0x002919.en: 「Dragon 2 to Iron 3!@ We'll cover your ship from here!」

0x002994.en: 「...While we were away in <La Gias>,@ things sure moved fast around here.」

0x002A2C.en: 「Hi there, Lamia!@ You can leave the rest to us now!」

0x002B59.en: 「Looks like we had you worried, Latooni.」

0x002BB5.en: 「Where in the world have you all been...!?」

0x002BF2.en: 「Details later. For now, let's clean up here.」

0x002C29.en: 「...Understood.@ They're aliens calling themselves the Guests.@ Seems they're connected to the Inspectors.」

0x002CAA.en: 「And the Guests didn't only appear here.@　Time is critical - take them down fast!」

0x002D27.en: 「Oh dear, the whole gang's here. Good timing@ or bad, hard to say. Well, work is work.」

0x002DA8.en: 「The commander is that man Zeb!@ Concentrate your fire on him!」

0x002DF8.en: 「Well then, shall we get to it?」

0x002E2F.en: 「An odd way of speaking...@ Though I'm hardly one to talk.」

0x002E85.en: 「Where else did you send your forces!?」

0x002EC8.en: 「To the places it'd hurt you most to have hit.」

0x002F0E.en: 「Whoa there, you got me, you got me.@ You're strong, I'll give you that.」

0x002F61.en: 「Well, if our operation's a success,@ there'll be another chance anyway.@ I'll pull out for today.」

0x002FF7.en: 「Hmm, not bad at all,@ Steel Dragon Squadron.@ No wonder Meki and the others lost.」

0x00308A.en: 「Well, if our operation's a success,@ there'll be another chance anyway.@ So then, I'll be taking my leave now.」

0x003154.en: 「Major Kai,@ if what he said is true, then right about now...」

0x003232.en: 「Well done, everyone.@ Stay on high anti-air alert and hold, ready for a second wave.」

0x00329D.en: (Heh heh heh, aliens...@ Don't think that same trick will keep working.)

0x003309.en: (...So the high alert these past days and that scramble earlier@ were preparations for this.)

0x003389.en: (But it's all too well-handled.@ It's as if the higher-ups knew@ the enemy would appear here today...)

0x00344F.en: 「Yeah, we'd have had more fun back in La Gias.」

0x0034F0.en: 「All Gamma Saber units,@　hold your positions and prepare for the second wave.」

0x00354C.en: 「Kind of a letdown for our real debut.@ Want me to just secure the Tesla lab while we're here?」

0x0035D8.en: 「Did you not hear my order? I said stand by.」

0x00362B.en: （Tch... what a boring old man, honestly.@　Gamma Saber ought to be just the two of us, nobody else.）

0x0036B8.en: 「...Such a shame. A perfect chance,@　and I couldn't bring out the Medius Locus.」

0x00372C.en: 「Have you forgotten?@　The Medius is supposed to have been stolen.@　Thanks to your and Mitarl's little plan.」

0x0037BC.en: 「Soon enough, none of that@　will matter anymore, will it?」

0x003818.en: 「Wh-what in the world is that unit...?」

0x003853.en: 「They just showed up out of nowhere,@　deployed, and then...」

0x0038B3.en: 「Nothing but machines I've never seen, save the Stork.@ New-model Lion types, and... the rest look like@ custom Guarlion variants?」

0x00395C.en: 「What worries me more is...@　they knew the enemy was coming.」

0x0039C1.en: 「Yeah, I tried to ask about that, and who they are...@　but got no response at all.」

0x003A2F.en: 「I can guess who the enemy is, but those people...」

0x003ADD.en: 「They've got new-model Lion types, so@　they might be tied to Isurugi, but...」

0x003B60.en: 「Could this be the rumored 'GS'?@　I'm grateful they saved the lab, but@　something about them smells off...」

0x003C00.en: 「...All targets destroyed.@　Beta 1 to all units. We're returning to base.」

0x003C53.en: （The timing matches the estimate too perfectly...@　No way this was predicted from <MOSS> data alone.）

0x003CE5.en: （Could it be the top brass knew@　exactly when the Guests would strike...?）

0x003DC6.en: 「Heh...@　Doesn't look like there's any work left for us.」

0x003E10.en: 「Commander Alteur, the Guest force is destroyed.」

0x003E63.en: 「Well done, Captain Carly Nauman.@　Fine command. I'll expect the same going forward.」

0x003EDA.en: 「Sir. You took me in, and now you've given me@　a post of such honor as well...@　I'll do everything to repay that debt.」

0x003FE0.en: 「...Alteur. It played out just as you said.」

0x004023.en: 「Yes. We also drove off the enemy forces@　that struck everywhere beyond Paris.」

0x004086.en: 「And the bombardment from extreme high altitude?」

0x0040BA.en: 「Besides the Federation's patrol squadron,@ we've sent the Omega and Beta Sabers.@ If there's any movement, we'll head it off in advance.」

0x004165.en: 「So you headed it off... or perhaps@　they never intended to try in the first place.」

0x0041DA.en: 「The latter, I believe.@　This one craves power more than his predecessor,@　so he'd avoid anything that undercuts his future footing.」

0x004295.en: 「Also, the Federation defended the bases and@ targeted cities, but this ship and the Alpha Saber@ saved Paris, our capital...」

0x004355.en: 「Whether it's the Federation or the Gaia Sabers whose feats@　burned themselves into the people's memory...@　I shouldn't need to say, should I?」

0x0043F1.en: 「The task you set before, Mr. President, of having@　the Gaia Sabers make a brilliant debut and@　outperform the Steel Dragons...」

0x0044A5.en: 「I believe we've now achieved it.@　How does that sit with you?」

0x0044FE.en: 「Indeed... it seems leaving it to you was the right call.」

0x00456C.en: 「I've laid groundwork in the military through my@ sympathizers, but some will team up with the@ assembly's opposition to dig up something on us.」

0x00460E.en: 「Especially the matter of predicting the Guest attack...@　that could become the crux. Leave no gaps in the spin.」

0x004697.en: 「Understood. Once the situation settles,@　you must give a speech, sir. Show the people that@　the Gaia Sabers are the sword that guards Earth.」

0x004757.en: 「Yes.@　In the battles with the Guests to come... claim victory, without fail.」

0x0047DB.en: Paris - Earth Federation Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x004809.en: Earth Federation Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x00483B.en: 「Marshal, the reports from each theater army are in.@　The opening battle is a sweeping victory for us.」

0x0048B6.en: 「They must be quite taken aback over there.@　So, where's the enemy main force?」

0x004921.en: 「Still searching, but since the <MOSS> probes@ haven't been attacked, they're likely somewhere@ beyond lunar orbit.」

0x0049E6.en: 「Their next target is likely the Moon and Heaven's@ Gate... surprising they didn't strike there first.@ Tighten the watch everywhere.」

0x004A94.en: 「Sir.@　By the way, about the President's speech earlier...@　is that quite all right?」

0x004AFA.en: 「It's what our supreme commander declared. No matter.」

0x004B3D.en: 「But with the Gaia Sabers' achievements trumpeted so...@　that leaves our own military with no standing.」

0x004BBD.en: 「They test new weapons without straining our@ budget, and fight the Guests aggressively too.@ Isn't that something to be thankful for?」

0x004C74.en: 「Alteur may mean to use the Gaia Sabers as a foothold@　to strengthen his voice within the military.」

0x004D03.en: 「Or he may be plotting with old armies outside@ the former UN Security Council's permanent@ members to overturn the Federation order...」

0x004DC0.en: 「You worry too much. Surely it won't come to that.@　Though even if he's thinking it, no matter.」

0x004E3D.en: 「One misstep and it's civil war... a grave problem, sir.」

0x004E80.en: 「A common outside enemy is a force that binds us together.@　Long ago, Bian Zoldark and Mayer V. Branstein@　proved as much.」

0x004F3D.en: 「And the DC War let anti-Federation elements blow@ off steam. No major civil war for a while now that@ a new outside enemy's appeared.」

0x004FFD.en: 「But the problem of the DC remnants and@　the anti-Federation ideologues still...」

0x005053.en: 「Our work grows, and the war merchants profit too.@ Better still, it's not our doing - some are willing@ to play the villain all on their own.」

0x00510D.en: 「Which lets us carry out our duty under a just cause.@　It's a crude way to put it, but we support each other.」

0x00519C.en: 「There's no such thing as perfect peace in this@ world. And a military bears a task as hard as@ beating an enemy... maybe harder.」

0x00526B.en: 「You mean how to keep the organization alive?」

0x00529F.en: 「Just so.@　Wiping out one's adversaries only serves to@　undermine one's own footing, Daniel.」

0x005320.en: 「...The Gaia Sabers may prove a dangerous cure, sir.」

0x005366.en: 「We have a remedy of our own.@　Pieces other than the Steel Dragons... Carlo and@　Ekkehard and the rest are getting things ready, no?」

0x005415.en: 「Then let Graien and Alteur have their little show@　in the run-up to the next presidential election.」

0x00549F.en: 「Besides, the tall tree catches the wind. The@ assembly's conservatives won't long tolerate the@ President's harsh wartime policies.」

0x005559.en: 「Until the tree falls,@　let's let Alteur and his lot work themselves to the bone...」

0x005606.en: 「Sorry to have worried you over all this, Latooni.」

0x00564C.en: 「No... I believed you'd all make it back safely, so...」

0x0056A8.en: 「I took plenty of photos of the new machines, too...」

0x0056E5.en: 「Oh, that's great. Thanks. Show me later.」

0x00578B.en: 「Princess Shine, I'm so glad you're safe...」

0x0057F7.en: 「I-I've been to the Principality of Riksent!@　I saw you in a parade!」

0x0058A8.en: 「S-so! If it's all right...@　could I have your, your Shine... ah, no!@　Your autograph!」

0x005988.en: 「By the way, Princess Shine...@　are you sure it's all right not to return home?」

0x0059F0.en: 「They've asked me to stay with the Steel Dragons@　a while longer as a witness to@　the incident in La Gias...」

0x005A80.en: 「Oh, but I did contact home just now.@　Joyce was overjoyed.」

0x005AFE.en: 「...Still, to think the whole lot of you@　had gone off to La Gias together.」

0x005B60.en: 「Well, it's a real long story if I start telling it.」

0x005BA0.en: 「Um... what about Kouta and Axel?@　They aren't with you?」

0x005BF9.en: 「I never met those two.@　No idea if they were even summoned to La Gias.」

0x005C92.en: 「Every Steel Dragon made it back, but... as for@ other surface-dwellers who ended up in La Gias,@ Masaki and his people are searching for them.」

0x005D5E.en: 「If those two are over there,@　they'll get them back to the surface.」

0x005DE8.en: 「Also, Arado... and there's something I have to@　tell Latooni and Seolla as well.」

0x005EB5.en: 「Yes... in La Gias, we fought@　three called Chienne, Chien, and Chiot.」

0x005F36.en: 「Those three were... of the Argent class...!」

0x005FAA.en: 「Nasty little brats, they were.@　Figure they're still in La Gias.」

0x00600C.en: （If those three come back to our side...@　then we'll...）

0x006062.en: （Survivors of the School...@　and it had to be them, of all people...）

0x0060C7.en: 「Plenty happened over there, but...@　sounds like there's trouble brewing up here too.」

0x006132.en: 「Yeah... I'll report on it once I've finished@　talking with Commander Lefina and the others.」

0x0061CB.en: 「Yeah, as an observer.@　There's likely to be a briefing on the situation@　after the Guest attack as well.」

0x0062B7.en: 「Yes.@　The Guests apparently used spatial-transfer tactics to@　ambush Paris, the theater bases, and key facilities...」

0x006350.en: 「...but they were stopped by the Federation and the 'GS'...@　the 'Gaia Sabers'」

0x0063C4.en: 「Gaia Sabers...@　So that's the official name of the President's own unit.」

0x006429.en: 「Yes. Just now, President Grusman's speech both@ declared a state of emergency over the Guest attack@ and made their existence public.」

0x0064CE.en: 「So long as the sword that guards Earth stands,@ humanity's sovereignty will never be violated...@ so the President is said to have declared.」

0x00655E.en: 「A sword, is it.@　If that refers to the Gaia Sabers alone,@　then he's slighting the Federation military.」

0x0065E5.en: 「Before that, one thing makes no sense to me.@ The Guests knew of the Huckebein at the Orleans@ factory, and caught on to Kurogane's moves.」

0x0066A5.en: 「Sending troops at us as well was surely@　learning the lesson of the <Inspector Incident>,@　but...」

0x006737.en: 「Impossible without gathering intel first.@ Learning from the <Inspector> failure, they@ moved from the start to seize Earth's core.」

0x00680B.en: 「In short, they gathered intel, aimed for certain@ victory, and struck many fronts at once.@ To think we stopped it this easily...」

0x0068FF.en: 「Isn't it possible the Joint Chiefs and the Gaia Sabers@　knew ahead of time exactly when@　the Guests would make their move?」

0x006A00.en: 「As I've said before, a pipeline existed between@ the Federation and the aliens. That channel seems@ still connected in some form, even now.」

0x006AC9.en: 「Also, judging from what that man Zeb said earlier,@　the Inspectors and the Guests, though the same power,@　seem to be on poor terms.」

0x006B80.en: 「It's possible the intel on the Guest attack@　came to us from@　the Inspectors' side.」

0x006C10.en: 「If they're the same power, their goal of@　conquering Earth ought to be the same, but...」

0x006C78.en: 「You're saying there's some kind of factional strife@　between the Inspectors and the Guests,@　and it got carried over here?」

0x006D08.en: 「Yes. The Guests' failure may well be@　convenient for the Inspectors.」

0x006D7C.en: 「If so, then I wish they'd stopped the Guests'@　invasion of Earth at an@　earlier stage...」

0x006DEE.en: 「It's precisely because they couldn't that@　they leaked the intel, one could argue.」

0x006E50.en: 「Factional strife in any world, huh.@　Even when they use the same line of weapons...」

0x006EF2.en: 「Roughly, yeah.@　Every enemy machine back there was a first sighting, but...」

0x006F58.en: 「One of the models used parts like@　those on the Geminila.」

0x006FBA.en: 「The Geminila... that was the code name of the@　transformable unit confirmed in the Inspector Incident.@　We never ran into that thing, but...」

0x007074.en: 「Unlike the Inspectors, it's safe to assume the Guests@　have brought in a fair number of their own@　machines.」

0x007107.en: 「Understood.@　Now then, as for our course of action going forward...」

0x00715A.en: 「When I contacted Far East Army HQ, orders came down@　to report in at once and explain@　the whole situation.」

0x0071ED.en: 「Accordingly, this ship and the Hagane@　will now return to Izu.」

0x00723D.en: 「Before that, there's something I'd like to ask of you...」

0x00729F.en: 「I'd like to take Bullet and Kusuha to the Tesla@ lab. Those two can commune with the Chokijin,@ so the RyuOhKi refit will move along.」

0x007371.en: 「Understood.@　The Chokijin will be needed to uncover Baral's true@　nature as well. Permission granted.」

0x0073EC.en: 「If the doctor's returning to the Tesla lab,@　wouldn't it be better to carry out the Exbein's@　repairs there too?」

0x00748C.en: 「Then we'll ferry it partway on the Kurogane.」

0x0074C3.en: 「Colonel Lefina, would it be all right to have@　Ryoto and Rio come along as well?」

0x007528.en: 「Those two were involved in developing the Huckebein@ Mk-III, so their support tuning the Exbein@ would be a great help.」

0x0075D0.en: 「...Lieutenant Colonel Tetsuya, what do you think?」

0x007604.en: 「No objection.@　In a situation like this, building up our forces is urgent.」

0x00765D.en: 「Then let all hands begin preparations to move out.」

0x0076A0.en: 「I see... so you all made it through safe.」

0x0076E7.en: 「Still, the field was every bit as tense@　as it was during the <Antarctic Incident>.」

0x007742.en: 「So, what did you want with me?」

0x0077AA.en: 「......is that what my old man told you to say?」

0x0077D8.en: 「Yeah... the investigation into 'Fabula Fores'@　has entered a new phase. And for that,@　we need the Sympatia.」

0x007880.en: 「A new phase, huh... how many times have I heard@　that one? There's been no real progress lately, right?」

0x00790C.en: 「This time is different.@　We need the Aile Chevalier, and fast.」

0x007965.en: 「And if this is about making Lim@　pilot the 01 again...!」

0x0079BE.en: 「The professor has no such intention.@　That's exactly why I called you.」

0x007A11.en: 「Then why won't my old man tell me himself?@　That man's always like this, when it counts...」

0x007A91.en: 「Josh... if the professor reached out to you,@　you wouldn't take the call, would you?」

0x007AFC.en: 「If there's progress, we might learn@　something about Lim's condition.@　...This is a request from me, too.」

0x007BCC.en: 「...Then Bullet, Kusuha, Ryoto and Rio,@　take the Kurogane to the Tesla Lab.」

0x007C65.en: 「Sorry to send you off right after you got back, but I'm counting on you.」

0x007CAB.en: 「Dr. Omiya, about the KoOhKi unit's whereabouts...」

0x007CEE.en: 「As it stands, we've next to nothing to go on.@　We're getting the LTR Organization's help@　with the Baral investigation, but...」

0x007D7E.en: 「I see... if I'd been at the site...」

0x007DB8.en: 「You might've been better off not there...@　Worst case, they'd have taken you along with it.」

0x007E3E.en: 「Um... Dr. Omiya,@ can the RyuOhKi unit really be restored...?」

0x007EA6.en: 「From what Director Kazahara says, it's fifty-fifty.@　And you and I are going to make it happen.」

0x007F3F.en: 「Major Kai, may I make a suggestion?」

0x007F86.en: 「I'd like to bring Ing to the Tesla Lab as well.」

0x007FE3.en: 「A boy Raul's group found drifting at sea@ in an escape pod after being shot down by@ an unknown enemy... we brought him aboard the Hagane.」

0x00808B.en: 「He's lost his past memories, so his origin is unknown.@　But in the fighting on La Gias,@　he cooperated with us.」

0x008127.en: 「You let someone of unknown origin fight?」

0x008161.en: 「Yes. By Captain Viletta's call,@ we put him in the R-Blade Custom.」

0x0081C9.en: 「Hold on. How could someone who lost his memory@　do such a thing? Are you saying his body remembered@　how to pilot a PT and how to fight?」

0x008277.en: 「Exactly. It seems he'd had advanced training before...@　His adaptability to the machine@　is remarkable.」

0x008316.en: 「Even so, throwing him into real combat...」

0x008356.en: 「At first, we were in a situation where we needed his combat strength...@ then we tried a kind of shock therapy to restore his memory.」

0x008414.en: 「No good.@　But there's been nothing suspicious in his conduct,@　and he himself is cooperative.」

0x008489.en: 「Even so... just from hearing this,@　I get the sense something about it is contrived.」

0x0084F7.en: 「That's why I want to take him to the Tesla Lab,@　to look into the mystery of Ing.@　He wants to know who he is, too...」

0x0085B1.en: 「If it's amnesia, wouldn't Dr. Kobayashi@　in Izu be the better choice?@　He's the expert in that field.」

0x008650.en: 「Captain Aya says that to look at this from multiple angles,@　it's better to have the Tesla Lab look him over first...」

0x0086D6.en: 「All right. I'll defer to the captain's judgment.」

0x008704.en: 「...Major Kai, do you have a moment?」

0x008738.en: 「We received word from Mother Base.@　We'd like to return to Antarctica for now.」

0x0087B2.en: 「You're not military personnel, so I've no objection, but...@　is it urgent?」

0x008802.en: 「Then I'll send out the transport we came in on.@　And I'll have Hugo and Aqua go with you.」

0x008886.en: 「They're not with my unit or the Steel Dragon Squadron either,@　so I can spare them. Take them as your escort.」

0x008919.en: 「You've already been attacked by Yokijin and Jinrai,@ and fought the Guests too. We'll likely run into@ enemy machines again along the way.」

0x008A02.en: 「Then I'll talk to Hugo and the others myself.@　Take great care on the road to Antarctica.」

0x008A95.en: 「Commander Zezernan, the first wave is all but wiped out.@　The Earthlings seem to have anticipated our surprise attack.」

0x008B2B.en: 「...In the scouting just before,@　they showed no sign of any such thing, did they?」

0x008B99.en: 「No... they were on a war footing, but@　to respond on so many fronts at once, and so swiftly...」

0x008C19.en: 「Well, well~, so the Steel Dragon Squadron@　isn't the only tough nut to crack~.」

0x008C7E.en: 「I can't believe every one of those apes is trained that well.@　However combative a species they may be.」

0x008D07.en: 「The information leaked in advance. There's no other explanation.@　...Surely it wasn't one of you?」

0x008DB8.en: 「Doing something like that~ wouldn't gain us a thing~.@　Wasn't it a mistake~ to lay hands@　on the Huckebein~ in the first place?」

0x008E9A.en: 「Have you forgotten? Securing the Granzon and the Huckebein@　is a high priority in this operation.」

0x008F20.en: 「Chafrois is right.@　The Granzon's whereabouts aside, the Huckebein@　had to be captured immediately.」

0x008FC8.en: （Though in the end~ it up and vanished~.）

0x008FF9.en: （But... why is the Commander so fixated@　on the Huckebein and the Granzon...?）

0x009067.en: 「And the other conceivable source of the leak~...@　might be the contact Wendro was using~?」

0x0090E4.en: 「Even so, that'd be one of Walga's people.@　How would they know the timing of our surprise attack?」

0x009161.en: 「True~. Then maybe a Walga spy@　slipped in somewhere~. Or maybe someone rigged@　one of the combat bioroids~.」

0x009224.en: 「I looked into it, but that's not it.」

0x009258.en: 「Then someone from Walga came~ to Earth@　and was watching~ us.」

0x0092C9.en: 「The transfer route Wendro's group used,@　we've seized and sealed it off, you know?」

0x009337.en: 「If the parties involved are still alive, there might be a way through...@ but no one else can use it without Zezernan's authentication code.」

0x009403.en: 「Continue investigating the leak.@　And the whereabouts of the Granzon as well.」

0x009478.en: 「Change the operation from here on... we take the Moon.@　Draw up an assault plan on the premise@　that the apes are lying in wait.」

0x009530.en: 「Reinforcements are already arranged.@ Next time, let the apes of Earth truly feel@ the Zovorg's power.」
